items.note: NL Fri 10am UK ≈ Oct 23 ~17:00 HKT (approx). Distinct from LRG physical story on dedupe—deadline PSA. imageUrl NL og:image.
items.imageAlt: Hitman Absolution Switch 2 Edition screenshot

items.title: Paralives first major update slips from end-2026 into 2027
items.summary: Paralives Studio 官方十月開發更新：首個大型更新原定 2026 年底，現需更多時間延至 2027；重點強化關係／互動、經濟曲線、新技能同職業、Build Mode 修復同 Paramaker 身體滑桿等。
items.note: Official Oct 23 2026 byline Gabrielle Boyer-Antoni. publishedAt date-only midnight HKT. No clear public og:image on fetch—imageUrl null. PC Early Access life-sim news.

items.title: Capcom: Onimusha: Way of the Sword difficulty ‘hit the right spot’ per player data
items.summary: Capcom 導演 Nihei 向 PC Gamer 表示，根據《鬼武者 Way of the Sword》玩家數據，難度接近團隊目標：有挫敗同死亡但仍可推進；並回應約 20 小時長度同重複 BOSS 嘅意見。
items.note: PC Gamer Published 23 October 2026; publishedAt date-only midnight HKT. Not on dedupe. imageUrl PC Gamer og:image.
items.imageAlt: Onimusha Way of the Sword combat screenshot

items.title: Katana ZERO DLC still coming, now ‘the size of a full sequel’
items.summary: Askiisoft 表示《Katana ZERO》期待已久嘅 DLC 仍在製作，規模已達「完整續作」並有逾 30 首新曲；先前曾稱免費，今次未再確認是否仍然免費，發售日未定。
items.note: uncertain=true: free status unclear per Gematsu. Oct 22 11:21 AM EDT = Oct 22 23:21 HKT. Not on dedupe. imageUrl Gematsu og:image.

items.title: Watch the Official Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer – Explore Leonida Before the Game Arrives November 19
items.summary: Xbox Wire 轉載 Rockstar《Grand Theft Auto VI》正式上市預告，強調 11 月 19 日登陸 Xbox Series X|S（同 PS5）；片段展示 Leonida 場景同 Jason、Lucia 前戲。

items.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 – Kill Block is Must-Play Multiplayer at Launch
items.summary: Xbox Wire 詳解《Modern Warfare 4》新模式 Kill Block：三塊模組化地圖每局重組，號稱逾 500 種配置，並支援 3v3／全新 10v10 Gunfight；遊戲已於 Xbox Series、PC、PS5 同 Switch 2 全球上市。
items.note: datePublished 2026-10-23T17:00:00Z to 2026-10-24T01:00 HKT. NEW vs Oct 23 pc-switch2 MW4 launch/OpenCritic items; this is Kill Block feature deep-dive.

items.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Alpha Demo survey results announced
items.summary: Koei Tecmo／Team NINJA 公布《Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember》Alpha Demo 問卷結果，將簡化 Insight Skill、調整 Spirit 同強化武技／仙術；遊戲訂 2027 年 3 月 4 日登陸 PS5、Xbox Series、Switch 2、PC 同 Game Pass。

items.title: Luma Island for PS5, Xbox Series launches December 2

items.title: Order of the Sinking Star physical edition launches in 2027
items.summary: PM Studios 將為 Jonathan Blow 嘅解謎冒險《Order of the Sinking Star》推出 PS5／Switch 2 實體版，暫定 2027 年；數位版已於 10 月 8 日上市，實體預購已開。

items.title: Xbox wanted $800 million from Netflix for 7 years of its biggest characters, it is claimed
items.summary: VGC 引述 Puck：Xbox 據報向 Netflix 開價 8 億美元換七年獨家改編最大 IP，Netflix 還價 5 億後破局；Xbox 聲明仍視 Netflix 為夥伴，並改為尋求更多細額合作。
items.note: VGC dated 23rd Oct 2026 / 4:26 pm (assumed UK BST to UTC+1 to 23:26 HKT). Claim via Puck; Xbox statement confirms interest but not dollar figures; uncertain=true.
items.imageAlt: Xbox and Netflix deal report illustration from VGC

items.title: Street Fighter 6 Players Reeling After Capcom Takes Down Popular Community Resource Site
items.summary: Kotaku 報道 Capcom 向 Ultimate Frame Data 發律師信，要求 10 月 30 日前下架《Street Fighter 6》碰撞框資料；站長已移除 SF6 內容，FGC 反應強烈。
items.note: Kotaku dated October 23, 2026; exact hour not in page metadata; publishedAt approx evening HKT. Distinct from Capcom ID breach IR notices.
items.imageAlt: Street Fighter 6 Capcom Ultimate Frame Data takedown story image

items.title: GameMaker GMRT runtime free for commercial use from January 1, 2027
items.summary: Opera 旗下 GameMaker 宣布由 2027 年 1 月 1 日起，次世代運行時 GMRT 可免費用於桌面／手機／網頁／GX Games 商業發行；主機輸出仍需 Enterprise 授權。
items.note: Official blog datePublished Thu Oct 22 2026 23:30:00 GMT to 2026-10-23T07:30 HKT. Also covered by GameDeveloper Oct 23.
